response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)') AS status, modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM base), grp AS (SELECT status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM base GROUP BY status), qual AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_by FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modindex, q.above_by, q.avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qual) AS diff_from_qual_mean FROM qual q ORDER BY q.status;
